title: Generate the files of every outputer in an Output Job
summary: Opens each OutJob of the focused project and calls IOutputer.DM_Generate_OutputFiles on its outputers one by one, reporting success and the generated file names, with a dry run and a filter by generator.
phrasings: run all outputs of an OutJob from code
generate NC drill files from an output job
list the outputers of the project's output jobs
get the file names an output generated

commands.name: GenerateOutputers
commands.description: For every OutJob of the focused project (optionally filtered by Job): open it (Show=true also shows it) and call DM_Generate_OutputFiles on each outputer (optionally filtered by Generator); report per outputer the success flag and returned file names, then the files new or changed under the project folder. DryRun=true lists the outputers only.
commands.params: Job=<part of the OutJob file name>|Generator=<';'-separated generator names or outputer descriptions>|Show=true|DryRun=true (all optional; default: every outputer of every OutJob, not shown)
